title: 1992 Comic Images Ghost Rider II #19 Stop It! Marvel Trading Card
descriptionText:
1992 Comic Images Ghost Rider II, card #19 - "Stop It!". Marvel / Ghost Rider non-sport trading card from the 80-card base set, with the comic artwork on the front and the numbered story panel on the back.

Condition: Very good to excellent. Front is bright with clean gloss, light corner and edge wear only; the back is clean and fully readable with normal age toning. No creases, tears or writing found. Please review both photos.

Ships in a penny sleeve and top loader.
